title.narrative: FUTUREPROOF EDUCATION: SUPPORTING SCHOOLS IN THE AI EVOLUTION

description.narrative: This project aims to support the ethical, meaningful, and safe integration of AI in school education in Belgium (Flanders and FwB), Germany (NWR), Ireland, Luxembourg, and Sweden. It has three outcomes: Outcome 1: The authorities have adopted or updated their strategies on the ethical, meaningful and safe implementation of AI in school education and are providing coherent and evidence-informed guidance to schools (all Member States/regions). Outcome 2: The authorities provide schools with change management tools, practice-oriented toolkits, and professional development resources to integrate AI into school education (all Member States/regions). Outcome 3: The authorities systematically co-operate with stakeholders on the safe introduction of new AI systems (Belgium/Flanders and Luxembourg) and integrate AI in existing learning resource platforms (Belgium/Flanders, Belgium/FW-B and Luxembourg).
